MOS bootstrapped track-and-hold switch
.include "circuit.spice"
.include "models.spice"
VDD vdd 0 3.3
VS sample 0 PULSE(0 3.3 20n 100p 100p 49.9n 100n)
VSB sampleb 0 PULSE(3.3 0 20n 100p 100p 49.9n 100n)
VIN vin 0 PWL(0 .5 79n .5 80n 1.6 179n 1.6 180n 2.8 300n 2.8)
XDUT vdd 0 sampleb vin g sample out astra_061_mos_bootstrapped_track_switch
.temp 27
.options method=gear reltol=1e-5
* @spec track0 range 0.48 0.52 unit=V
* @spec gate0 range 2.3 3.5 unit=V
* @spec track1 range 1.58 1.62 unit=V
* @spec gate1 range 3.4000000000000004 4.6 unit=V
* @spec track2 range 2.78 2.82 unit=V
* @spec gate2 range 4.6 5.8 unit=V
* @spec hold0 range 0.48 0.52 unit=V
* @spec hold1 range 1.58 1.62 unit=V
.control
set filetype=ascii
tran 20p 300n
meas tran track0 FIND v(out) AT=50n
meas tran gate0 FIND v(g) AT=50n
meas tran track1 FIND v(out) AT=150n
meas tran gate1 FIND v(g) AT=150n
meas tran track2 FIND v(out) AT=250n
meas tran gate2 FIND v(g) AT=250n
meas tran hold0 FIND v(out) AT=110n
meas tran hold1 FIND v(out) AT=210n
write out.raw v(out) v(g) v(vin) v(sample) v(sampleb)
quit
.endc
.end
